decision.observation: Manual Generator panel: Status 'No Power Wire Connected / Generator Idle / Missing Tile' — the generator's footprint lost a supporting tile, so it's broken. Panel shows Deconstruct and priority options; world markers [3] at ~(0.69,0.71) and (0.72,0.71) are its cells.
decision.hypothesis: The generator sits where digging removed a floor tile. Deconstructing it refunds ~200 kg copper ore, which can rebuild a generator on solid floor with the existing wire.
decision.memory: Generator needs solid ground under footprint. Wire chain runs at y≈0.62 from diffuser to ladder base. Deconstruct button in panel ~(0.794,0.603).
